instructions: Choose one ordinary keyboard or mouse input using the screenshot. Keyboard inputs are held for 3 seconds. Left click performs the primary action on the visible target; right click performs its secondary action. Pointing without clicking reveals the native hover label. A drag moves a visible object to a visible destination. Mouse targets are selected from the current screenshot. The profile describes controls only and provides no game objectives. The number keys 1 through 9 and 0 activate inventory slots 1 through 10 using the native inventory action for the item in that slot. Hovering an inventory item displays its native action label. The native mouse-operated crafting bar uses left clicks to toggle category tabs and pointer hover to select entries; clicking an entry or its native button activates it. The separate keyboard-operated crafting panel uses W/S to select a category, A/D to select an entry, and Space to activate the current selection. In that keyboard panel, a mouse click activates the current selection; moving the pointer does not select another entry.

action.instructions: Select one ordinary input. Its key combination, pointer action or scroll is executed as a single action.

up.description: Hold W to move up. In the keyboard-operated crafting panel, selects the previous category.

left.description: Hold A to move left. In the keyboard-operated crafting panel, selects the previous entry.

down.description: Hold S to move down. In the keyboard-operated crafting panel, selects the next category.

right.description: Hold D to move right. In the keyboard-operated crafting panel, selects the next entry.

up_left.description: Hold W and A to move diagonally up and left.

up_right.description: Hold W and D to move diagonally up and right.

down_left.description: Hold S and A to move diagonally down and left.

down_right.description: Hold S and D to move diagonally down and right.

context_action.description: Hold Space to perform an available nearby contextual action. In the keyboard-operated crafting panel, activates the current selection.

attack.description: Hold F to attack a nearby target.

escape.description: Press Escape to open or close the current menu.

map.description: Press Tab to toggle the map.

confirm.description: Press Return to confirm the selected menu item.

rotate_left.description: Press Q to rotate the camera left.

rotate_right.description: Press E to rotate the camera right.

scroll_up.description: Scroll one wheel step upward at the current pointer position.

scroll_down.description: Scroll one wheel step downward at the current pointer position.

inventory_slot_1.description: Press 1 to activate the item in inventory slot 1. The native item action depends on that item.

inventory_slot_2.description: Press 2 to activate the item in inventory slot 2. The native item action depends on that item.

inventory_slot_3.description: Press 3 to activate the item in inventory slot 3. The native item action depends on that item.

inventory_slot_4.description: Press 4 to activate the item in inventory slot 4. The native item action depends on that item.

inventory_slot_5.description: Press 5 to activate the item in inventory slot 5. The native item action depends on that item.

inventory_slot_6.description: Press 6 to activate the item in inventory slot 6. The native item action depends on that item.

inventory_slot_7.description: Press 7 to activate the item in inventory slot 7. The native item action depends on that item.

inventory_slot_8.description: Press 8 to activate the item in inventory slot 8. The native item action depends on that item.

inventory_slot_9.description: Press 9 to activate the item in inventory slot 9. The native item action depends on that item.

inventory_slot_10.description: Press 0 to activate the item in inventory slot 10. The native item action depends on that item.

click_target.description: Left-click a visible target to perform its primary mouse action.

secondary_target.description: Right-click a visible target to perform its secondary mouse action.

point_target.description: Move the pointer to a visible target without clicking.

drag_target.description: Drag a visible object to a visible destination.
